title.narrative: FDB Climate Finance and FX Strategies

description.narrative: This project supports the Fiji Development Bank (FDB) to strengthen its climate finance framework and expand access to green loan products. It will enhance FDB’s Climate Finance Strategy, develop new loan products in renewable energy, electric mobility, and climate adaptation, and establish monitoring systems for emissions impact reporting. The project also develops resource mobilization and risk management plans to address financing and foreign exchange risks, enabling FDB to fully leverage facilities such as the EURIZ guarantee scheme and Fiji’s Blue Bonds program. Through a combination of technical assistance, market studies, product design, and staff training, the project aims to position FDB as Fiji’s leading financial institution for climate-aligned lending.

To strengthen FDB’s climate finance strategy and loan offerings, while building financing mechanisms and monitoring systems that enable sustainable lending aligned with Fiji’s climate and development priorities.
